text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: sustained 5xx and latency degradation on Dedicated pool dp-eu-central (prod). Autoscaler lagging, backlog increasing. Please follow /runbooks/dedicated-pool-surge. Pager duty alert has been sent.

omar: Acknowledged. Observed QPS spike from ~2400 to ~6200 in ~5 minutes. p95 generation latency up to 2.8s, error rate 6% across the pool. Beginning live mitigations.

rebecca: Metrics: two nodes at 100% GPU, rest at ~85%. Autoscaler started creating nodes but provisioning time ~3-5m, so requests piling into the queue. Kernel queue length doubling.

jin: Proposal: 1) enable burst pool attachment for dp-eu-central to add 3 ephemeral instances for 10m, 2) apply temporary tenant-level token-rate caps to top noisy tenants, 3) if needed, disable noncritical features for low tiers. Thoughts?

omar: Agree. I'll enable burst attach and apply a quick throttle to the top offending tenant proto-labs. Also open a status note for support to notify impacted customers.

tessa: I can handle customer comms and create the incident page. Support-bot, list customers with >2% 5xx.

support-bot: Customers with >2% 5xx: proto-labs, synthmetrics, bizmail. Degraded latency (p95>1.5s): proto-labs, bizmail.

omar: Executing burst attach:```shell
# attach 3 burst instances to dp-eu-central for 10 minutes
rctl dedicated burst-attach --pool dp-eu-central --count 3 --ttl 10m --reason "emergency surge"
```

omar: CLI output: ```
SUCCESS: burst attach request accepted. request_id=b-1799-euc-334. Expected attach ≈ 25s. Expires 10m.
```

rebecca: I see three new hosts registering: burst-euc-12, burst-euc-13, burst-euc-14. GPUs attached. Kernel queues clearing, errors falling. p95 down to ~1.0s after attach.

omar: Applying tenant throttle for proto-labs:```shell
# limit proto-labs to 50 concurrent requests and 60 qps for 15m
rctl tenant throttle --tenant proto-labs --concurrency 50 --qps 60 --duration 15m --note "emergency throttle during autoscale lag"
```

omar: API response: `OK: throttle applied, rule_id=th-9982`

jin: After throttle, proto-labs qps dropped from 3400 to ~900. Pool-wide tail latency improved. No new 5xx seen in last 90s.

tessa: I posted a short status update: "Investigating elevated errors in dp-eu-central. Temporary mitigations in place; monitoring." Support notified affected tenants.

infra-bot: Warning: one burst host reported elevated KV cache eviction rate. Monitoring only; no client errors. Auto-evict policy active.

rebecca: Note: we saw a minor side-effect where structured-output endpoints returned truncated JSON for some low-tier requests after throttle—likely due to request cancellation at the gateway. No user-facing 5xx but some incomplete responses logged.

omar: If truncation persists we should consider disabling structured-output on low tiers briefly. For now keep watch.

jin: Timeline: keep burst attach for full 10m unless stability reached earlier. If tail latency <1s and 5xx <0.5% for two consecutive 5m windows, plan rollback: remove tenant throttles and detach burst.

rebecca: I'll create a quick grafana alert to watch p95 and 5xx for dp-eu-central and tag the incident.

omar: Handoff: my rotation ends in ~8m. @jin will be on-call next. Jin, can you own the rollback decision after my handoff?

jin: Ack, I'll take over. I'll revert throttle + detach burst once stable for two 5m windows, or earlier if issues recur.

tessa: Filing follow-ups: 1) retro to reduce autoscale cold start times and pre-warm known high-qps tenants, 2) playbook to automatically apply soft throttles earlier, 3) evaluate cost impact of burst usage.

infra-bot: Reminder: tag incident with `dedicated-autoscale` and include runbook link.

omar: Adding final notes to the thread: commands run, affected customers, timestamps, metrics snapshot. Leaving monitoring to Jin.

jin: Took handoff at 1799000120. Monitoring. If stable, I'll remove throttle and detach burst per plan.

support-bot: Customer notifications sent: short email to affected customers + incident page link.

jin: After two stable windows, performing rollback:```shell
# remove throttle rule
rctl tenant throttle remove --rule th-9982
# detach burst instances early
rctl dedicated burst-detach --pool dp-eu-central --request b-1799-euc-334 --force
```

jin: CLI responses: `OK: throttle removed`, `OK: burst detach started, expected cleanup within 45s`.

rebecca: Post-rollback metrics: p95 ~0.95s, 5xx <0.4%, queue lengths normalized. No further action required.

tessa: Closing incident on status page and creating retro ticket. Thanks all. :clap:

incident-bot: Please file a short incident report in /incidents with tag dedicated-autoscale and link to this thread.

omar: Good work team. Handed off and signing out.
